name: Small Vending Machine

pages.text: It's a vending machine. It allows anyone to easily trade using boondollars! The boondollars are stored in the machine, alongside its contents.$(br)It can hold up to 9 extra stacks of items in its internal buffer.
Combine a Dropper and a Gold Nugget in a Punch Designix.

pages: To open the storage, you must be the machine's owner and crouch when right-clicking. You must also be the machine's owner to destroy it.
